about: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc., an industrial gases company, provides industrial gases, related equipment, and applications to the energy, environmental, and other markets in the Americas, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, India, and internationally. The company produces and sells atmospheric gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, and argon; process gases, such as hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, and syngas; and specialty gases through on-site gases supply mode or merchant gases supply mode.
